conditions.build: Tauri debug with embedded frontend and LUMAPAINT_RENDER_METRICS=1

conditions.actions: After warmup click (400,300) and drag (400,350)-(580,350), five drags (400,y)-(580,y), y=380,410,440,470,500. CUA AX observation after each drag.
